verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents its own ReadMe API for controlling docs programmatically, and export is available through the API as well as the UI. An official CLI (rdme) also exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covers every UI action, such as settings, appearance, custom domains, team management, reviews or AI features. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, API coverage of admin/config/appearance/team features, and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Control your docs programmatically with the ReadMe API
Export your docs using our built-in features, tooling, and our API.
